title: braille display shows what the reader speaks

clauses.text: the words the reader speaks appear on a connected USB HID braille display, and the line pans and routes back to the text

steps.do: Connect a USB HID braille display that follows the USB HID braille standard, turn the screen reader on, and move the focus across a few words.
steps.expect: The words the reader speaks appear in the braille cells; a line longer than the display pans with the display's keys, and a routing key on a cell moves to the character it came from.

clauses.text: the Accessibility switch for contracted braille (key G) changes the line shown on the display

steps.do: Open Settings, Accessibility, press G to turn contracted braille on, then read the same words on the display. Turn it off again.
steps.expect: The shell rewrites the line on the display at once: short words such as 'the' and 'and' take one cell when the switch is on.
